_comment: Written by /jarvis-voice from the interview and from what this machine can actually run. Change a value, save, restart the voice.
_names: Both of these are read by main.py for the spoken greeting. Leave them empty and it introduces itself as 'Hey there, Assistant is online' — which is the first thing anyone hears, and it undoes the whole point of a vault that already knows who they are. Fill them from the vault, never ask.
_ptt: The key you hold to talk. right_ctrl on Windows; a MacBook has no right Ctrl, so use right_alt (the right Option key) there.
_tts: engine is 'piper' (works on any machine), 'kokoro' (better, needs a working NVIDIA card) or 'mac' (the Mac's own voice, named in mac_voice; empty means the system default). Kokoro speaks English only. A Piper voice is always installed as well, so a broken graphics driver leaves you with a slightly plainer voice rather than a silent one.
